summary: Iteration 22 backend testing: verified new /api/auto/preset-counts endpoint, van/pickup preset regex, scraper autoloop wiring in auto_scheduler, plus regressions on body-type-counts, capture-hammer, sold-history, and is_non_vehicle whitelist. 8/8 pytest tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: PRESET_FILTERS regex in auto_routes.py mirrors _VEHICLE_TITLE_WORDS in auto_source_importers.py — consider extracting to a shared constants module to avoid drift when new pickup/van models are added.
auto_routes.py is ~1800 lines; approaching split threshold — presets, scheduler-status and admin/intel endpoints could each move into routes/auto/ submodules.
auto_scheduler.py uses module-level globals for every loop's state — consider a small dataclass registry to make status()/stop() less error-prone as more loops are added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter22_scraper_presets.py covers preset-counts, /api/auto/vehicles?search=<regex> matching, scheduler module constants + status() shape (scraper_autoloop key), body-type-counts, capture-hammer, sold-history, and is_non_vehicle. Note: blacklist uses 'cement mixer' not 'concrete mixer'. Verified live counts: van_pickup preset count > 100 (was ~267 at test time); /api/auto/vehicles total drift within 10% tolerance. Scheduler constants SCRAPER_INTERVAL_SECONDS=3600, SCRAPER_LIMIT_PER_SOURCE=50 confirmed.
